_: Shared packs (workstream CHARS, Nov 3 2026, design/godot-build-hosting.md 'Shared packs'). Files listed here are NOT in any wing pack: each is its own pack, <name>.desktop.pck / <name>.mobile.pck, downloaded once into the browser's cache and mounted at runtime by scripts/shared_packs.gd. include: project paths (globs, as export filters) of the files it holds; Godot adds their dependencies. at: 'start' = downloaded with the wing pack, mounted before the wing's scene loads (anything a scene or the item list refers to). CHAR-STRIP (Nov 8 2026): there are no 'later' packs any more (the character packs went with the editor); never add one for people, whose files must be in before the card lifts. A new Blender item under models/bl_<store>_<item>/ lands in 'items' with no change here. PRIZES (Nov 3 2026): prizes/* (the prize counters' pictures, used by both years' counters and the prize items) is in 'items' too. SEAMLESS (Nov 13 2026, design/godot-build-hosting.md 'The common pack'): 'common' holds what every wing pack carried a copy of, byte for byte: the cast's bodies (cast/*.glb and their pictures; cast/*.json stays in the wing packs with the other data) and the animation library npc/anims.res. It is people, so it is 'start' like 'items': in before the card lifts. A new cast member under cast/ lands in it with no change here.
